what: Log S118 (decisions S71, S72): the numbers the S118 results use. Taken from the full output of tools/s118_gather_the_results_fixed.py (scratch space s118/gathered.json) and of tools/s118_after_reading_count_solvers_among_programs_that_copy.py (s118/posthoc.json, a check made after the results were read). Raw output stays in the scratch space.

pilots_are_execution_environments.any_function: P1 ANY FUNCTION, RARE PAYS MORE: the execution environment pays the same for any of the 251 functions of Avida's 77 logic tasks, each from its own resource that runs down when many programs use it
pilots_are_execution_environments.must_solve: P2 SOLVE SOMETHING TO REPLICATE, NOTHING PAID: from update 5,000 the execution environment lets a program complete a copy only if it performed at least one of the 77 tasks during that copy; nothing is paid

cpu.note: Each per-run figure is at most about 20 seconds short. The original script summed overlapping figures (three runs at once); see tools/s118_gather_the_results_fixed.py.

any_function_seed1_resource_levels_at_20: Resource of the most common task (orn, 2,952 of 3,596 programs) at 168 (pay 0.42 of a doubling); of tasks performed by no program 9,950 (pay capped at 1.0). So common pays less; rarity beyond the cap is not paid more.
